title: Best Practices

body.text: a complete CLAUDE.md · start big work in Plan Mode · commit often · tests as a safety net · review every diff
— AI makes you many times faster, but an engineer's basic discipline matters just as much.

example: "Morning start: claude → /review yesterday's work → Plan Mode for today's work → run subtasks during the meeting"

body.text: the core tools, agentic workflow, MCP, hooks, permissions, multi-agent, and slash commands
